annotations.title: Close or notify later, while you are away

description: Use whenever the user wants something done later on a held position: "close it if still open in 3 days", "tell me if its funding passes 50% a year", "close half below 94000". TradeHub keeps watching after this session ends; you cannot schedule checks yourself. Up to 5 rules, each fires once and either notifies the person or closes part of the position reduce-only. Not a stop-loss. A new plan replaces the old; rules=[] removes it. Next: get_my_positions.

rules.description: Up to 5 rules, each fires once; [] removes the plan

action.description: notify: tell the person (Telegram, events, webhooks); close: close close_fraction of the position, reduce-only

close_fraction.description: close only: share of the position, a fraction: 0.5 = half, 1 = all (default)

value.description: USD per coin for prices; hours (0.1-720); funding as a yearly fraction (0.5 = 50%)

when.description: price_above / price_below: the mark crosses value; held_hours: value hours after the plan is set; funding_above: the yearly funding rate this position pays reaches value

thesis.description: Why the position is open and what would prove it wrong, for the next session to read back; seen only by you and the person

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid if connected, else your only connected exchange, else the sandbox
